'''Cosia''' was a celestial body located in the [[Cosia system/Legends|Cosia system]] of the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Cosian/Legends|Cosian]]<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''</ref> [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]<ref name="SWE">{{SWE|characters|terasinube|Tera Sinube}}</ref> [[Tera Sinube/Legends|Tera Sinube]], who utilized a [[Tera Sinube's sabercane|sabercane]] with a [[Cosian wood/Legends|Cosian wood]] [[Sabercane/Legends|hilt]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

==Behind the scenes==
Cosia was mentioned in the [[2010]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia]]'' by [[Jason Fry]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Cosia [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the celestial body, in grid square M-11.<ref name="EAOC" />
